name: Bretten (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Bretten (blue and white lozenges).
history: Municipal flag of Bretten; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Bretten arms — blue and white lozenges
